ipa.financial_contracts.swap.PricingParameters

API endpoint for Financial Contract analytics, that returns calculations relevant to each contract type.

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts.swap.PricingParameters.

Syntax

PricingParameters(
    *,
    index_convexity_adjustment_integration_method: IndexConvexityAdjustmentIntegrationMethod | str = None,
    index_convexity_adjustment_method: IndexConvexityAdjustmentMethod | str = None,
    price_side: PriceSide | str = None,
    tenor_reference_date: TenorReferenceDate | str = None,
    discounting_ccy: str | None = None,
    discounting_tenor: str | None = None,
    market_data_date: OptDateTime = None,
    market_value_in_deal_ccy: float | None = None,
    report_ccy: str | None = None,
    use_legs_signing: bool | None = None,
    valuation_date: OptDateTime = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
index_convexity_adjustment_integration_method IndexConvexityAdjustmentIntegrationMethod | str No None The integration method used for static replication method. the possible values are: riemannsum, rungekutta. the default value is 'riemannsum'.
index_convexity_adjustment_method IndexConvexityAdjustmentMethod | str No None The convexity adjustment type for constant maturity swaps (cms) and libor in-arrears swaps. the possible values are: none, blackscholes, linearswapmodel, replication. the default value is 'blackscholes'.
price_side PriceSide | str No None The quoted price side of the instrument. optional. default value is 'mid'.
tenor_reference_date TenorReferenceDate | str No None In case the swap definition uses 'starttenor', 'starttenor' defines whether the swap start date is calculated from valuation date or from spot date
discounting_ccy str | None No None The currency code, which defines the choice of the discounting curve. the value is expressed in iso 4217 alphabetical format (e.g. 'usd'). by default, settlementccy or the paid leg currency is used.
discounting_tenor str | None No None
market_data_date OptDateTime No None The date at which the market data is retrieved. the value is expressed in iso 8601 format: yyyy-mm-ddt[hh]:[mm]:[ss]z (e.g., '2021-01-01t00:00:00z'). it should be less or equal tovaluationdate). optional. by default,marketdatadateisvaluationdateor today.
market_value_in_deal_ccy float | None No None The dirty market value of the instrument computed as [cleanmarketvalueindealccy+accruedamountindealccy]. the value is expressed in the deal currency. the default value is '0'.
report_ccy str | None No None The reporting currency code, expressed in iso 4217 alphabetical format (e.g., 'usd'). it is set for the fields ending with 'xxxinreportccy'. optional. the default value is the notional currency.
use_legs_signing bool | None No None Enable the signing of "risk measures" and "valuation" outputs based on leg's direction the default value is false.
valuation_date OptDateTime No None The date at which the instrument is valued. the value is expressed in iso 8601 format: yyyy-mm-ddt[hh]:[mm]:[ss]z (e.g., '2021-01-01t00:00:00z'). by default, marketdatadate is used. if marketdatadate is not specified, the default value is today.
